statements.attributed: found the supercooling method to be a very efficient way to achieve rapid solidification even with very slow cooling rate
statements.quote: One specific method called supercooling method, which can thermodynamically cool the alloy melts (can up to a few hundred K) below its melting point, was found to be a very efficient way to achieve rapid solidification even with very slow cooling rate.

statements.attributed: found the maximum undercooling of Cu was increased when magnetic field was applied and the magnetic field can suppress the irregular and unexpected large decrease of undercooling
statements.quote: Hasegawa et al. studied the undercooling of Cu in 0.5 T magnetic field and found the maximum undercooling was increased when magnetic field was applied and the magnetic field can suppress the irregular and unexpected large decrease of undercooling.

statements.attributed: found that the convection in the levitated Cu and Cu-1%Ag melt was remarkably reduced but the nucleation temperature was not affected by the field

statements.attributed: found α Co is ferromagnetic once the temperature is below 1329 K
statements.quote: The two phases, α Co and β Co3Sn2, have quite different magnetic properties, and α Co is found to be ferromagnetic once the temperature is below 1329 K while β Co3Sn2 is paramagnetic phase.

statements.attributed: showed that the near eutectic Co-Sn alloy holds quite stable β Co3Sn2 and α Co clusters in the overheated melts
statements.quote: Even though it is stressed that metallic melts possess their own characteristic ordering structure that is usually independent of the corresponding solid phases, the X-ray diffraction results showed that the near eutectic Co-Sn alloy holds quite stable β Co3Sn2 and α Co clusters in the overheated melts which is consistent with its solid structure.

statements.attributed: found that the maximum nucleation temperature was not visibly affected by the external field since the undercooling did not surpass the Curie point
statements.quote: So the maximum nucleation temperature was not visibly affected by the external field since the undercooling did not surpass the Curie point at which the magnetic contribution could change the nucleation temperature dramatically.

statements.attributed: found the wetting angle is altered and the surface tension between the melt and the glass slag is enlarged when the shape changed from spherical to a pie like shape
statements.quote: The sample shape variation also can destroy the equilibrium between the sample and glass slag, e.g. the wetting angle is altered and the surface tension between the melt and the glass slag is enlarged when the shape changed from spherical to a pie like shape, which can decrease the mean undercooling.

statements.attributed: predicted that defects and stress formed in the solid skeleton upon rapid solidification save energy, which will reduce the latent heat release and consequently decrease the recalescence temperature
statements.quote: One possible explanation is due to the existence of defects (such as dislocation, vacancy) and stress formed in the solid skeleton upon rapid solidification that much energy is saved in the as-formed solid skeleton upon recalescence, which will reduce the latent heat release and consequently, decrease T R .
